bugs.description: The URL input field contains 'https://www.website.com' which appears to be a valid HTTPS URL, yet an error message 'Please provide a correct https url. Enter an HTTPS url.' is displayed. This indicates a potential UI bug (misleading error) or an issue with the URL validation logic, as a standard valid URL is being flagged as incorrect.

The app incorrectly flags 'https://www.website.com' as an invalid HTTPS URL, displaying 'Please provide a correct https url. Enter an HTTPS url.' This prevents navigating to the default site and seems like a validation bug.

Bug: The app incorrectly validates 'https://www.google.com' as an invalid HTTPS URL. After inputting 'https://www.google.com' into the 'URL input field' and clicking 'Go To Site button', the app displays an error message 'Please provide a correct https url. Enter an HTTPS url.'. This is incorrect as 'https://www.google.com' is a valid HTTPS URL.
